verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs describe a Postgres endpoint aimed at 'BI tools, any Postgres client' that needs no DuckDB install, which implies standard Postgres drivers can connect dashboards. Its docs also cite official drivers and SDKs, including Java. However, the evidence never names JDBC or ODBC drivers or any specific BI-tool integration guide (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker), so dashboard connectivity is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, named BI-tool integration guides, and independent or hands-on confirmation of BI dashboards connecting.
